claims: The Sun is ~4.6 billion years old.
The Sun is a G-type main-sequence star.
The Sun is at the center of our solar system.
In ~5 billion years, the Sun will exhaust its hydrogen.
The Sun will expand into a red giant.
The Sun is roughly halfway through its 10-billion-year lifespan.
The Sun contains 99.8% of the solar system's mass.
The Sun is a sphere of plasma.
Ra is the Egyptian sun god.
Helios is the Greek sun god.
Huitzilopochtli is the Aztec sun god.
The distance from the Sun to Earth is ~93 million miles (150 million km).
The Sun's lifespan is ~10 billion years.
The Sun's composition is primarily hydrogen fusing into helium.
